name: Humanoid Golem

pages.text: Humanoid golem is a player-like golem. It can use armor, meelee weapons, bows, crossbows, trident, and shield. Right click the golem with equipments to equip, and shift-right click the golem to un-equip all. If you shift-right click with empty hand, the golem will be retrieved naked as well. Right click the golem with empty hand to retrieve the golem with equipments stored within.
Humanoid golem can perform area attack if and only if it holds a sword-like item.$(br2)Humanoid golem can use shield, trident, bow, and crossbow.

Use the $(l)Skin Button$() in the Humanoid Golem equipment screen to change its skin.$(br2)Supported input formats:$(br2)$(li)$(l)Player Name$() - Use the Minecraft skin of a player$(li)$(l)Resource Path$() - Use a custom texture from resource packs, e.g.:$(br)modulargolems:textures/iws2000.png$(li)$(l)Entity id() - Use texture from vanilla zombie / skeleton / piglin variants, e.g.:$(br)minecraft:drowned$(br2)Right-click the button to reset to default skin.

pages: If Touhou Little Maid is installed, use the $(l)Maid Skin Button$() in the equipment screen to switch to a maid model.
